import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w

user32=c.windll.user32
ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS=-1
ENUM_REGISTRY_SETTINGS=-2
class DEVMODEW(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[
      ("dmDeviceName",c.c_wchar*32),("dmSpecVersion",w.WORD),("dmDriverVersion",w.WORD),
      ("dmSize",w.WORD),("dmDriverExtra",w.WORD),("dmFields",w.DWORD),
      ("dmPositionX",c.c_long),("dmPositionY",c.c_long),("dmDisplayOrientation",w.DWORD),
      ("dmDisplayFixedOutput",w.DWORD),("dmColor",c.c_short),("dmDuplex",c.c_short),
      ("dmYResolution",c.c_short),("dmTTOption",c.c_short),("dmCollate",c.c_short),
      ("dmFormName",c.c_wchar*32),("dmLogPixels",w.WORD),("dmBitsPerPel",w.DWORD),
      ("dmPelsWidth",w.DWORD),("dmPelsHeight",w.DWORD),("dmDisplayFlags",w.DWORD),
      ("dmDisplayFrequency",w.DWORD),("dmICMMethod",w.DWORD),("dmICMIntent",w.DWORD),
      ("dmMediaType",w.DWORD),("dmDitherType",w.DWORD),("dmReserved1",w.DWORD),
      ("dmReserved2",w.DWORD),("dmPanningWidth",w.DWORD),("dmPanningHeight",w.DWORD)]
user32.EnumDisplaySettingsW.argtypes=[c.c_wchar_p,w.DWORD,c.POINTER(DEVMODEW)]
user32.EnumDisplaySettingsW.restype=w.BOOL
for label,idx in (("CURRENT",0xffffffff),("REGISTRY",0xfffffffe)):
    dm=DEVMODEW();dm.dmSize=c.sizeof(DEVMODEW)
    if user32.EnumDisplaySettingsW(None,idx,c.byref(dm)):
        print(label,dm.dmPelsWidth,dm.dmPelsHeight,dm.dmBitsPerPel,dm.dmDisplayFrequency,flush=True)
modes={}
i=0
while True:
    dm=DEVMODEW();dm.dmSize=c.sizeof(DEVMODEW)
    if not user32.EnumDisplaySettingsW(None,i,c.byref(dm)):break
    key=(int(dm.dmPelsWidth),int(dm.dmPelsHeight),int(dm.dmBitsPerPel),int(dm.dmDisplayFrequency))
    modes[key]=1;i+=1
print("MODE_COUNT",len(modes),flush=True)
for m in sorted(modes):
    if m[0]>=1280 or m[1]>=900:
        print("MODE",m,flush=True)
